fact: The INS published on 6 June 2024 the first edition of the Statistical Yearbook of the Education and Training Sector in Cameroon, 2021-2022, of education administrative data disaggregated by region down to district level, with more data on the online EMIS platform.
title: Statistical Yearbook of the Education and Training Sector in Cameroon 2021-2022
publisher: Institut National de la Statistique du Cameroun
